source.title: Đáp án/transcript: TOEIC LR Collection 1 Test 7 - STUDY4

children.text: (A) A man is reading a book.
(B) A man is sitting at a table.
(C) A man is opening a window.
(D) A man is pushing a cart.
(A) Some benches have been placed under a pavilion.
(B) Some plants are arranged around a lamppost.
(C) There's a fountain beside the pathway.
(D) Some trees are shading the benches.
(A) A server is watering some plants.
(B) Some people are seated at the tables.
(C) A server is stacking some chairs.
(D) Umbrellas have been opened over the tables.
(C) She is pushing a cart along an aisle.
(D) She has stacked boxes on a shelf.
Who's going to report on the city-council election next week?
(A) The council meets on Thursday evening.
(B) She filed her report on time.
(C) One of the newer staff writers, I believe.
Which counter should I take my golf clubs to for check-in?
(A) Any of the oversized-baggage desks will handle those.
(B) I checked in online this morning.
(C) The departure gate is on the upper level.
Where's the lead architect working these days?
(C) Oh, the design team shifted up to the third floor.
Are you running the children's story hour this afternoon?
How did the sign-ups for our new swimming lessons turn out this season?
(A) The swelling lessens after a day or two.
(B) She teaches the morning swim class.
(C) They came in nearly a third higher than last year.
Why did Nathan get to the studio so late this morning?
There's a spot open on the lighting crew for the next show.
(A) No, the lights are all turned off now.
(B) Actually, I've done that kind of work before.
(C) They said the rehearsal ran a bit late.
When does the evening spin class begin?
Where's this year's charity gala being held?
(A) It's over at the Grandview Ballroom.
(B) We're still a bit short on volunteers.
Please stock the refrigerator with fresh ingredients before the evening service starts.
(A) Right behind the prep counter, near the sink.
(B) I'll take care of that as soon as I've finished this order.
(C) No, the soup came out a little cold.
Has our building permit been issued yet?
(B) The inspector still has to sign off.
Is the greenhouse tour led by a guide, or are we free to walk through it on our own?
(A) The guide should be here soon.
(C) You're welcome to go through it yourselves.
Would you rather run the new campaign on the radio or online?
(A) Could you turn the radio down?
(B) Most of our customers are teenagers.
(C) The election results came out yesterday.
Could you recommend somewhere nearby to grab lunch?
(A) The recommendation letter is on your desk.
(B) I usually bring my own lunch.
(C) There's a great sandwich place just around the corner.
When will my prescription be ready?
(A) At the pharmacy on the corner.
(C) Just two boxes left in stock.
How did the weekend charity run turn out?
(A) You can register at the front desk.
(B) Turn right at the second light.
(C) I was out of town all weekend.
When are we supposed to hear back from the property inspector?
(B) Down in the basement, I think.
How are we going to cut down on all this wasted fabric?
(A) By laying the pieces closer together.
(B) She usually works in the cutting room.
(C) No, it wasn't a waste of money.
Isn't Warren the one who fitted my new glasses?
(A) Right over by the window display.
(B) Yes, he's helping someone right now.
(C) No, the classes begin at nine.
Weren't you planning to take the photography class this evening?
Do you know if this novel's available in paperback?
(A) They're right at the back of the store.
(B) Yes, I lent her my copy last week.
(C) I'll look it up in our system.
Why didn't Wesley take the early route into the city this morning?
You've already backed up the server files, haven't you?
(A) The system's been down all morning.
(B) No, the printouts haven't been collected.
Why did you close your register so early tonight?
(A) Because there weren't any shoppers left.
(C) We close at ten on weekends.
When does the next ferry to the island leave?
(B) The island's really lovely this time of year.
